assets.edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided historical Brown Creeper illustration. Remove the ENTIRE tree trunk and all branches, twigs, moss, ground and pale paper/background. Retain ONLY the single Brown Creeper bird on genuine transparent alpha. Preserve its exact original head-up climbing pose, left/up-pointing long curved bill, eye, brown and cream speckled plumage, folded wings, long pointed brown tail, and visible legs, toes and claws. Keep the historical printed illustration appearance, pigment colors, proportions and feather patterns as close to the input as possible. Where the toes gripped the tree, remove the wood without adding wood-colored halos; retain the existing toe shapes, do not invent new limbs or alter the bird's pose. Keep entire bill, claws and tail in frame with small transparent padding. No text, shadows, paper, perch or added object.

review.species_check: Compared the edited bird with the same pinned historical source figure and the source catalogue's scientific-name mapping; no other species is substituted.
review.orientation: Single Brown Creeper in the original head-up climbing pose; curved bill points upper-left, folded wings, long pointed tail and visible gripping toes are retained.
review.crop: Entire trunk, branches, moss and paper removed. Exactly one bird remains on transparent alpha; bill, toes and tail inspected at full size.
review.scope: Inspected the complete transparent output at full size against the input historical cutout. AI-assisted cleanup is explicitly disclosed; source pigment identity and scientifically reconstructed hidden anatomy are not claimed.
